title: I looked for the lamp which she told me
html_source: This phrase comes from Thomas Moore’s The Song of O'Ruark, Prince of Breffni in his Irish Melodies, which tells of a young man looking for a lamp in a window as a sign of his love’s eager anticipation of his return, only to see no such token. The “young false one” had abandoned him for a “proud rival’s kiss.”
